mapper.select: SELECT r.owner_doctor_id AS owner, r.request_id AS requestId,r.request_sha256 AS requestHash,r.application_id AS applicationId, r.source,r.reference_id AS referenceId,r.purpose_code AS purposeCode,r.verified_summary AS summary,r.created_at_ms AS createdAt, r.mail_state AS mailState,r.attempt_id AS attemptId,r.attempt_no AS attemptNo,r.attempt_started_at_ms AS attemptStartedAt,r.decided_at_ms AS decidedAt,r.mail_from AS mailFrom,r.last_error AS lastError, a.id AS legacyId,a.doctor_id AS legacyOwner,DATE_FORMAT(a.start_date,'%Y-%m-%d') AS startDate,DATE_FORMAT(a.end_date,'%Y-%m-%d') AS endDate,a.reason,a.mail_to AS mailTo,a.mail_sent AS mailSent FROM ra_ai_export_request r LEFT JOIN export_application a ON a.id=r.application_id WHERE r.owner_doctor_id=#{owner} AND r.request_id=#{requestId}AND r.application_id=#{applicationId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE ra_ai_export_request SET application_id=#{applicationId} WHERE owner_doctor_id=#{owner} AND request_id=#{requestId} AND application_id IS NULL

UPDATE ra_ai_export_request SET mail_state='UNKNOWN',attempt_id=#{attemptId},attempt_no=#{nextAttemptNo},attempt_started_at_ms=#{now},decided_at_ms=NULL,last_error='IN_PROGRESS_OR_UNCERTAIN',mail_from=#{mailFrom} WHERE owner_doctor_id=#{owner} AND application_id=#{applicationId} AND mail_state=#{oldState} AND attempt_no=#{attemptNo}
UPDATE export_application SET mail_to=#{mailTo} WHERE doctor_id=#{owner} AND id=#{applicationId} AND mail_to IS NULL AND mail_sent=0
UPDATE export_application SET mail_sent=1 WHERE doctor_id=#{owner} AND id=#{applicationId} AND mail_sent=0

UPDATE ra_ai_export_request SET mail_state=#{newState},last_error=#{lastError},decided_at_ms=#{now} WHERE owner_doctor_id=#{owner} AND application_id=#{applicationId} AND mail_state='UNKNOWN' AND attempt_id=#{attemptId} AND attempt_no=#{attemptNo}
